(AP Photo/Colin Hubbard)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.The 2026 NBA Playoff bracket is almost set, but first, it’s play-in time. Amazon Prime VideoGet a month of Prime Video for free, and watch the NBA Play-In Tournament when you subscribe to Amazon Prime today.Subscribe nowThe 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament kicks off today, March 14, with the Miami Heat facing off against the Charlotte Hornets. Play-In games are ONLY on Amazon Prime Video — and there’s a way you can watch them for FREE. Those new to Prime can take advantage of the streamer’s 30-day free trial, meaning you can watch the entire tournament (and part of the NBA Playoffs) for free. How does the NBA Play-In Tournament work?To understand how the Play-In Tournament works, it’s important to know what the Play-In Tournament is. What is the NBA Play-In Tournament? The NBA Play-In Tournament is a mini-tournament that determines the final playoff spots in each conference. In it, teams ranked 7th-10th in each conference’s regular season standings face off for a chance to earn the final two playoff spots (seeds 7 and 8). The tournament takes place after the regular season but before the first round of playoffs.Here’s how it works:7th seed vs 8th seed → The winner gets the 7th playoff spot; loser gets another chance9th seed vs 10th seed → The winner advances; the loser is eliminatedFollow-up game → Loser of game 1 plays winner of game 2 for the 8th playoff spotEach game is single elimination. Only the 7th and 8th seeds from this tournament advance to the playoffs. The tournament was introduced by the NBA in 2021 to keep more teams in contention late in the regular season, making those final weeks more competitive and, well, fun. Check out the full NBA Play-In bracket here. When is the NBA Play-In Tournament? DatesThe NBA Play-In Tournament runs from April 14 through April 17. How many games are in the NBA Play-In Tournament?The NBA Play-In Tournament consists of six games.
